description: Official World Golf Ranking (OWGR public ranking API, no key): current men's position, player name, country, total points, average points and last week's position for the top players. Current ranking only; no tour or event history. Related tools on this server, for a different need: search_fifa_team_rankings when you need FIFA men's national team world ranking: position, team; search_world_rugby_rankings when you need World Rugby men's 15s world rankings: position, team. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many players from the top, 1 to 50 (default 10)
